findings.message: The slice `rows[start : start + size + 1]` returns `size + 1` users per page, so every page is one item too long. Each page also repeats the first user of the next page.
findings.suggestion: return [User(r["id"], r["email"], r["name"]) for r in rows[start : start + size]]

findings.message: The query now fetches every row of the users table into memory on each page request and slices in Python. Memory use and latency grow with the size of the table, unlike the previous `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` query. For `page < 1`, the negative start index also silently returns rows from the end of the list.
